cases.expect: Terminal event preserves original_rows and candidate_rows; report displays their actual difference.
Old events remain readable and explicitly state that original/candidate data is missing.
Second run adds eight SKIP events without another repair call.

evidence_policy: Existing crops may accompany reports. Missing crops are marked missing; report generation does not fail solely for this reason.
limitations: Bounded raw responses may be truncated; interrupted requests may lack a result. Events are evidence, not deterministic model replay.
Fixture repairs are not model performance.
trace_contract: Preserve original checks, every completed candidate and rejection, safe provider reasons and HTTP attempts. Reuse requires input/context hashes; current-run reports do not sum historical requests.
